_comment: The Guild Ledger (LedgerManager.gd): renown standings for you and every active adventurer, scored the same way for both. Renown = rank x per_rank + guild points x per_point + deepest floor cleared x per_floor + bosses slain x per_boss + level x per_level + world firsts x per_first. Movers are measured against the snapshot taken at the start of each week.
